# paperclip Provider

The Paperclip provider manages companies, agents, goals and projects on a [Paperclip](https://paperclip.ing) instance, so that an AI agent organisation can be declared, reviewed and versioned as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    paperclip = {
      source = "KhaosSystems/paperclip"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and API key can also be supplied through the
# PAPERCLIP_API_URL and PAPERCLIP_API_KEY environment variables.
provider "paperclip" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:3100"

  # Not needed for instances running in the local_trusted deployment mode.
  api_key = var.paperclip_api_key
}

variable "paperclip_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Board API key used to authenticate. Not needed for instances that run in the `local_trusted` deployment mode. Can also be set with the `PAPERCLIP_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Paperclip instance, for example `http://localhost:3100`. Can also be set with the `PAPERCLIP_API_URL` environment variable.
- `max_retries` (Number) Number of times a request is retried after a transient failure (rate limiting or a temporarily unavailable server). Defaults to `3`; `0` disables retries.
